zh-TW.c_mapAttribution: 地形成本與一般活動點為遊戲配置。圖資：
zh-TW.c_roadMapAttribution: 道路依來源拓樸；地景與一般活動點為遊戲配置。圖資：
zh-TW.c_pollNote: 民調為兩日一次的遊戲快照，不隨當日行動即時更新。
zh-TW.c_rumorNote: 封關期間僅提供前一晚的質性回報，實際支持點留待選後公布。
zh-TW.c_mapReadingHelp: 六角形＝移動格；屋舍、植栽＝裝飾；實際道路有路名與分類；圓形圖示＝活動點。
zh-TW.c_roadMapReading: 一套 100 公尺格徑六角格；棋子固定在道路錨點。建物為 OSM 逐棟輪廓，衛星 DSM 顯示地表；金線預覽、青線紀錄步行，風格插畫可另行開關。
zh-TW.c_realRoadHelp: 走向與路名來自真實道路資料；幾何線寬僅供辨識。移動與 AP 仍依 380 公尺六角格，不是逐街步行導航；圖上相交不代表平面連通。
zh-TW.c_streetRoadHelp: 新局沿來源道路節點尋路，線條交叉不自動連通。高速／快速道路及明示禁止通行路段不開放。普通道路缺步行標記時採遊戲推定，非現實導航；舊局沿用原格網。
zh-TW.c_roadHexHelp: 依真實線段與完整六角格相交查詢；有道路不表示該格能通行，也不代表曾走過。
zh-TW.c_roadNameFallback: 路名依來源原文顯示。本次來源未附英文路名；未自行翻譯。
zh-TW.c_roadSnapshot: 圖資截至 {{date}} · 本區 {{count}} 段
zh-TW.c_assumedWalk: 部分路段未標示步行權限，依遊戲政策推定通行。
zh-TW.c_surfaceModelNote: Copernicus GLO-30 地表模型（DSM）含屋頂、設施與樹冠；主量測 2011–2015，使用 2021 公開快照，局部可能由更早模型補洞。不是裸地／路面實測，不改變 AP。
zh-TW.c_surfaceDatum: EGM2008 高程基準・30m 重新取樣網格；小數不代表測繪精度
zh-TW.c_buildingCoverage: 依來源逐棟輪廓查詢，保留中庭孔洞。OSM 並未涵蓋現實每棟建物，空白處不補造；來源名稱與高度也可能缺漏。
zh-TW.c_buildingSourceNote: 逐棟輪廓取自 2026-10-29 OSM／Geofabrik PBF，裁切原始官方區界並投影至 EPSG:3826。高度、樓層僅顯示可解析來源標記，不推算；不是地籍或全棟測繪成果。
zh-TW.c_surfaceSourceNote: GLO-30 原生約 30m（1 弧秒），由衛星量測衍生；本機雙線性重投影為 30m 網格。陰影與每 50m 等高線描述地表，不能當作人行道、建物或樹木的精確高差。
zh-TW.c_geoLicence: 來源授權與衍生資料下載
zh-TW.c_sceneSchematic: 圖鑑插畫為區域風格示意；地圖逐棟輪廓與高程另有來源圖層。
zh-TW.m_vehicleNote_jiang: 藍黃車隊符號為遊戲創作；造型參考公開車隊影像，未核實有同名本屆車輛。
zh-TW.m_vehicleNote_shen: 參考本屆洋流號的暖橘木紋皮卡與船舵，轉譯為卡通載具。
zh-TW.m_vehicleNote_huang: 白紫載具為遊戲創作，參考 2022 年車掃；不是今年參選資料。
zh-TW.m_previewNote: 上層是低角度舞台與旗海，下層是俯視策畫室；圖表、訊息流皆為演出示意，與支持度無關。可隨時略過，系統減少動畫設定優先。
zh-TW.m_voiceNote: 人潮底聲為多層合成；「凍蒜、凍蒜、加油、凍蒜」使用通用合成人聲，不模仿真人。發音為臺灣華語近似，非臺語母語群眾實錄。
zh-TW.m_credits: 查核日 2026-11-01。角色為虛構卡通，立繪由 AI 生成，兵種與載具為原創向量。2026《台北安可》《台北順起來》及 2022《33 theme》僅列研究，沒有收錄、仿寫或 remix 原曲；黃珊珊採四年前視覺參考，未表示本屆參選或官方合作。

zh-TW.c_progressHelp: 只顯示你方紀錄。足跡含部署、移動與接駁抵達；勾選代表本局在此辦過活動。次數為今日一般活動，隔天歸零，舞台場次另計。
zh-TW.c_planBudgetHelp: 依目前隊員與你方資源估算，一次執行一點；執行後會重新計算其他選項。
zh-TW.g_explain: 經驗來自有效活動，每人每日最多 8；移動與休息不給經驗。升級不補當下 AP。士氣影響宣講，健康與疲勞影響翌日 AP；休息可恢復。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300100: 夜市牌樓、條紋棚攤與沿街燈籠，描繪饒河街周邊的商街氣氛。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300200: 以台北 101 的層疊輪廓搭配玻璃高樓、開放廣場與行道樹。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300300: 大安森林公園的樹冠與步道，銜接低層屋舍、綠帶與休憩長椅。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300400: 美術館的錯落量體、幾何雕塑與街角綠意，組成藝文街區。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300500: 紀念堂屋頂、對稱柱廊與階梯廣場，保留開闊的公共空間感。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300600: 大稻埕碼頭的船帆、水紋與磚色山牆，連起老街拱廊意象。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300700: 龍山寺的燕尾屋脊、燈籠與廟埕階梯，搭配老城低層街廓。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300800: 動物園入口意象、丘陵等高紋、茶園植列與坡地小屋。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6300900: 流行音樂中心的折面輪廓，延伸為金屬街廓與層次廣場。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6301000: 碧山巖的山寺輪廓，搭配玻璃辦公樓、綠坡與山城階線。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6301100: 故宮青瓦屋簷、對稱庭院與山麓植栽，形成庭園街景。
zh-TW.c_sceneBody_6301200: 溫泉博物館的磚牆、斜瓦屋頂與蒸氣線條，融入綠坡步道。

zh-TW.m_intro: 三位虛構主將、三輛競選載具與三首原創陣營曲。點選角色，再試播掃街、出發、舞台或技能演出；試播不消耗 AP，也不改變對局。
zh-TW.m_original: 本作原創，未使用競選歌曲錄音或旋律。
zh-TW.m_importNote: 支援瀏覽器可解碼的音訊，上限 20 MB、1–600 秒；只播放前 20 秒。檔案留在此分頁記憶體，不上傳、不寫入對局存檔，重新整理後恢復原創曲。
zh-TW.m_trackNote_blue: D 大調・144 BPM，明亮主旋律與動漫熱血節拍。
zh-TW.m_trackNote_green: E 大調・144 BPM，波浪琶音與輕快電氣流行。
zh-TW.m_trackNote_white: G 大調・144 BPM，鋼琴音色與清亮合成器。
zh-TW.c_guide1: 共 28 天，每日分白天與晚上。日夜共用 AP；夜間結束後對手行動，再結算活動。
zh-TW.c_guide2: 全市總覽選擇行政區，再進入共用六角格地圖。切換視角不耗時、不重設單位。
zh-TW.c_guide3: 新局使用格徑 100 公尺道路六角格：選空格預覽真實道路，再確認移動。AP 依整條加權道路距離每 100 公尺向上取整；階梯、雨天、未應變的施工各增加一倍路段權重。舊局保留 380 公尺格網與原地形成本。
zh-TW.c_guide4: 掃街與拜訪各需 2 AP、1 物資，每節點每日最多兩次。每日補充 8 物資。疲勞會降低隔日 AP，休整可恢復疲勞與動員力。
zh-TW.c_guide5: 跨區接駁每隊員每日一次，需 6 AP、4 物資並增加疲勞。先在地圖選目的區，行動面板即可派遣。
zh-TW.c_guide6: 在舞台場地附近設立治疏嶼或恰恰肥皂箱。準備完成後指派一名志工，再主動舉辦場次；每舞台每日一次，無人經營不會自動生效。
zh-TW.c_guide7: 重要地標須控制未受爭奪、有隊員駐守，且當日在本區完成活動。達成地標特殊條件另有加成；可調整結算優先順序，每日最多三個。
zh-TW.c_guide8: 兵種相剋：鐵票樁腳 → 鍵盤側翼 → 狂熱小草 → 鐵票樁腳。重裝減傷，遠程可範圍宣講，刺客可繞背。動員力耗盡者翌日回基地。
zh-TW.c_guide9: 第 2、4、6、8、10、12、14 天公布前一晚民調；第 15–28 天只提供小道消息。第 7、21 天政見發表，第 14、27 天辯論。第 28 天夜間結算後，總支持點較高者勝，同分則平手；此時才解封實際數字。
zh-TW.c_guide10: 開局先選藍、橙或白方，再選虛構主將。預設為將千秋、申博衍、黃若水；各方都有三類兵種，兩個對手每晚輪流先行。主將冷卻均為六天。
zh-TW.c_guide11: 重裝駐守花 2 AP、再減少 2 動員力損耗，但當日不能移動。遠程範圍宣講花 4 AP／1 物資，作用於目標及相鄰對手。刺客背襲花 3 AP，須在目標背面相鄰格，影響加成在相剋後、減傷前計算。
zh-TW.c_guide12: 每逢奇數日抽取虛構十月驚奇，偶數日不保留。應變花 2 AP／2 物資，可解除本隊負面影響；動員花 2 AP 並暫派一名志工至翌晨，爭取地方聲勢。物資到站應變另獲物資，夜市加開場應變另有地方反應。
zh-TW.c_guide13: 民調比例包含三方。第 28 天最後夜間比較三方全市支持點，最高者勝；最高分並列則平手。封關仍只顯示前兩名差距的質性消息。
zh-TW.c_guide14: 每次成功行動與日夜切換後自動保存，也可立即存檔。回首頁或重新整理後選「繼續競選」。存檔限此瀏覽器及網址，清除網站資料會移除；新局需確認覆寫。
zh-TW.c_guide15: 街區只有一套對齊的六角格。淡藍色為當前隊員可達範圍，金線為待確認路線。足跡記錄你方本局到達過的格子；勾選記錄辦過活動的地點。今日一般活動兩次上限隔天歸零，累計紀錄與存檔保留。
zh-TW.c_guide16: 活動清單會計算移動加掃街的總 AP 與物資，前往並掃街會保留掃街所需資源；資源或人流不足時整筆不執行。青色實線記錄選定隊員今日每段實際步行，編號表示先後；接駁不偽裝成步行。
zh-TW.c_guide17: 各區圖鑑保留風格插畫。地圖的逐棟建物來自 OSM，與可另開的風格插畫分開；衛星 DSM 高程來源及限制詳見圖層說明，不改道路 AP。
zh-TW.c_guide18: 真實道路底圖提供原始路名、分類與搜尋。淡紫色定位道路，不代表可步行；金色預覽及青色紀錄才是遊戲尋路。橋梁、隧道與高架依 OSM 節點引用連通，沒有來源連接的交叉不變成路口。缺英文路名時保留原名。
zh-TW.c_guide19: 新局採道路模式，舊存檔保留原位置、AP 與歷史，不自動升級地圖。新版存檔保存路網修訂，版本不符會拒絕讀取。這是離線戰術模型，未標示步行權限的普通道路依遊戲政策推定，非實測導航或現實通行保證。
zh-TW.c_guide20: 逐棟建物依 OSM 輪廓繪製，中庭保留挖空；選格後可在建物清單查高度、樓層與來源，未知不補造。衛星地表採約 30m GLO-30（主量測 2011–2015、2021 快照），含屋頂與樹冠；可開陰影、50m 等高線與預覽路線剖面。它不是裸地或路面實測，不影響 AP；舊存檔及戰術規則保持相容。

en.c_mapAttribution: Terrain costs and ordinary stops are game designs. Sources:
en.c_roadMapAttribution: Routes follow source topology; scenery and ordinary stops are game designs. Sources:
en.c_pollNote: Polls are game snapshots issued every two days, not live action scores.
en.c_rumorNote: During blackout, reports describe the previous night qualitatively. Scores are revealed after the final settlement.
en.c_mapReadingHelp: Hexagons are movement cells; buildings and planting are scenery; real roads have names and classes; round markers are activity locations.
en.c_roadMapReading: One 100 m hex grid; units use fixed road anchors. Buildings use OSM footprints; the satellite DSM shows the surface. Gold previews routes and cyan records walks. Illustrative scenery has a separate toggle.
en.c_realRoadHelp: Geometry and names come from real road data; line widths are illustrative. Movement and AP still use 380 m hexes, not street-by-street walking navigation. Crossings may be grade-separated.
en.c_streetRoadHelp: New campaigns follow source road nodes; crossing lines do not automatically connect. Expressways and explicitly restricted sections are excluded. Ordinary roads with missing foot tags use a game assumption. This is not real-world navigation. Legacy campaigns retain their grid.
en.c_roadHexHelp: Based on real lines intersecting the full hex. A road does not make the hex passable or count as a recorded visit.
en.c_roadNameFallback: Street names retain their source spelling. This extract has no English-name field; no translations are invented.
en.c_assumedWalk: Some sections have no foot-access tag and are assumed walkable by game policy.
en.c_surfaceModelNote: Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model (DSM), including roofs, infrastructure and tree canopy. Main acquisition: 2011–2015; this is the 2021 public release, with possible older gap-filling. It is not a bare-earth or road survey and does not change AP.
en.c_surfaceDatum: EGM2008 vertical datum · resampled 30 m grid; decimals do not imply survey accuracy
en.c_buildingCoverage: Queries individual source footprints and preserves courtyard holes. OSM does not cover every real building. Blank areas are not filled with invented buildings; source names and heights may also be missing.
en.c_buildingSourceNote: Individual footprints come from the 2026-10-29 OSM / Geofabrik PBF, clipped to the original official city boundary and projected to EPSG:3826. Heights and storeys use interpretable source tags only, without estimation. This is not cadastral or complete surveyed building coverage.
en.c_surfaceSourceNote: GLO-30 has nominal ~30 m (1 arc-second) native spacing and is satellite-derived. The local subset is bilinearly reprojected to a 30 m grid. Hillshade and 50 m contours describe the surface, not precise differences between pavements, buildings or trees.
en.c_geoLicence: Source licences and derived data downloads
en.c_sceneSchematic: Atlas artwork illustrates district character; sourced building footprints and elevation have separate map layers.
en.m_vehicleNote_jiang: Fictional blue-and-yellow vehicle, inspired by public campaign convoys. No same-name 2026 vehicle was verified.
en.m_vehicleNote_shen: Cartoon adaptation of the current Ocean Current pickup, with warm orange wood-grain panels and a ship’s wheel.
en.m_vehicleNote_huang: Fictional white-and-lavender vehicle inspired by the 2022 convoy; not a current candidacy claim.
en.m_previewNote: A low-angle stage and flag crowd above; a top-down strategy room below. Charts and feeds are theatrical schematics, unrelated to support. Skip at any time; system reduced-motion preferences take priority.
en.m_voiceNote: Crowd ambience is layered synthesis. The cheer uses generic synthetic voices, without imitating a real person. Pronunciation is a Taiwanese Mandarin approximation, not a native Hokkien crowd recording.
en.m_credits: Checked 2026-11-01. Fictional cartoon characters with AI-generated portraits and original vector roles and vehicles. The 2026 songs Taipei Encore and Taipei Flows, and the 2022 33 theme, are research references only; no original recording, melody recreation or remix is included. Huang’s reference is from four years earlier, with no claim of current candidacy or official collaboration.

en.c_progressHelp: Only your faction’s records appear. Footprints include deployment, movement and charter arrivals. Checks mark locations where you held an activity. Counts are today’s ordinary activities, reset each morning; stage sessions are counted separately.
en.c_planBudgetHelp: Estimates use the selected member and your resources. Choose one location at a time; other options update after each action.
en.g_explain: Earn experience through activities, up to 8 per member daily; moving and resting award none. Levels never refill current AP. Morale affects rallies; health and fatigue affect daily AP. Rest restores condition.

en.m_intro: Three fictional commanders, three campaign vehicles and three original faction themes. Select a character, then preview a street, departure, stage or skill scene. Previews cost no AP and do not change your campaign.

en.m_importNote: Use browser-decodable audio up to 20 MB and 1–600 seconds; only the first 20 seconds play. Files stay in this tab’s memory, are never uploaded or included in campaign saves, and reset to originals on reload.

en.c_guide1: Play 28 days, each with day and night. AP carries between phases. Your opponent acts at night’s end before settlement.
en.c_guide2: Select a district on the atlas, then enter the shared hex map. Changing views spends no time and never resets units.
en.c_guide3: New campaigns use 100 m road hexes. Select an empty hex to preview a road route, then confirm. AP rounds the full weighted route up per 100 m; stairs, rain and unadapted roadworks each add one section multiplier. Legacy campaigns retain 380 m hexes and original terrain costs.
en.c_guide4: Canvassing and visits cost 2 AP and 1 material, with two visits per node daily. Supplies gain 8 materials each morning. Fatigue reduces next-day AP; rest restores fatigue and mobilization.
en.c_guide5: Each member may charter once daily for 6 AP and 4 materials, gaining fatigue. Choose a destination district, then use the action panel.
en.c_guide6: Build either stage brand near a venue. After construction, assign a volunteer and actively run events, once per stage daily. Unstaffed stages earn nothing.
en.c_guide7: Hold a Wonder uncontested with a nearby team member and a local activity that day. Its special condition adds a bonus. Set priorities; at most three Wonders pay out daily.
en.c_guide8: Class counters: Iron Broker → Keyboard Wing → Grassblade → Iron Broker. Armor reduces loss, ranged units broadcast to an area, and scouts can flank. Depleted members return to base next morning.
en.c_guide9: Polls arrive on days 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14. Days 15–28 provide qualitative street reports. Presentations: days 7 and 21; debates: 14 and 27. After day 28’s final night, higher total support wins; equal totals draw. Actual scores unlock then.
en.c_guide10: Choose Blue, Orange or White, then a fictional commander. Defaults are Jiang, Shen and Huang. Each faction has all three classes; the two opponents alternate who acts first each night. Commander cooldowns are six days.
en.c_guide11: Bracing costs 2 AP, adds 2 protection and locks movement today. Area broadcast costs 4 AP and 1 material, affecting the target and adjacent rivals. Rear flank costs 3 AP, requires an adjacent rear position, and adds its multiplier after the class counter but before protection.
en.c_guide12: Fictional October Surprises are drawn on odd days and expire the next morning. Adapt for 2 AP and 2 materials to remove your side’s penalty. Mobilize for 2 AP and reserve a volunteer until morning for local momentum. Delivery adaptation grants materials; night-fair adaptation boosts local response.
en.c_guide13: Poll shares include all three factions. After the final night of day 28, the highest citywide score wins; a tie for first is a draw. During blackout, only qualitative reports about the two front-runners appear.
en.c_guide14: Successful actions and phase changes save automatically; Save now is also available. Choose Continue campaign after returning home or reloading. Saves belong to this browser and address and are removed by clearing site data. Replacing a save requires confirmation.
en.c_guide15: The street map uses one aligned hex grid. Pale blue shows cells the selected member can reach; gold marks a pending route. Footprints record cells your faction reached; checks mark activity locations. The two-visit ordinary activity cap resets daily, while campaign progress remains saved.
en.c_guide16: The location list shows combined movement and canvassing costs. Move & canvass reserves the required resources; if resources or the visit limit prevent it, nothing is spent. Solid cyan lines show the selected member’s actual walks today in numbered order. Charters are not shown as walks.
en.c_guide17: District atlases retain illustrative artwork. Map footprints come from OSM and are separate from optional illustrative scenery. Satellite DSM dates and limitations appear in the layer controls; elevations do not alter road AP.
en.c_guide18: The road basemap provides source names, classes and search. Lavender locates a road and does not establish walkability; gold previews and cyan records game routes. Bridges, tunnels and overpasses follow OSM node references. Geometric crossings do not create junctions. Missing English names fall back to the original name.
en.c_guide19: New campaigns use road mode. Legacy saves preserve positions, AP and history without map migration. New saves record a road revision and reject mismatches. This offline tactics model assumes access on ordinary roads with missing foot tags; it is not surveyed navigation or a guarantee of real access.
en.c_guide20: Building footprints follow OSM geometry, retaining courtyard holes. Select a hex and inspect source height, storeys and IDs; missing values remain unknown. The ~30 m GLO-30 surface (main acquisition 2011–2015, 2021 release) includes roofs and canopy, with hillshade, 50 m contours and route profiles. It is not bare-earth or surveyed road elevation and does not affect AP. Existing saves and tactical rules remain compatible.
en.c_roadAPHelp: Road AP = total weighted metres / 100, rounded up; any move costs at least 1 AP. Stairs, rain and unadapted roadworks each add one to the affected section’s multiplier. Illustrated slopes add no cost. Water crossings require source road connections; charter travel is separate.
en.c_trailHelp: Footprints: campaign arrivals. Solid cyan: this member’s walks today. Dashed gold: pending preview. Check: completed activity.
